title: Book One · Chapter 78: The Short Ruler
story:
Ronan has enough money for one small thing at Mr Qiu's stall.

He wants a new ruler. His old one has a corner missing. The numbers still work, but the edge catches on paper.

The long ruler costs more than he has. The short one is yellow. It has a hole at one end. A little flower is printed beside it.

“That one is for girls,” Leo says.

Mr Qiu lifts the ruler from its hook. “Does the flower change the length?”

“No.”

“Then it can measure your line too.”

Leo looks at a plain ruler in another box. It costs the same as the long one. Ronan turns the yellow ruler over.

“Can I use it here?” he asks.

Mr Qiu puts a scrap of wrapping paper on the counter. Ronan draws a line. The pencil moves smoothly along the edge.

He gives Mr Qiu his coins.

“Do you want a piece of paper for the price?” Mr Qiu asks.

Ronan shakes his head, then changes his mind. He took this money from his own small box. He wants to show Mum the new ruler.

Mr Qiu writes the price. Ronan checks the coins and the change. Then he puts them away. No money goes missing. It is just a slower part of buying.

At home, Mum likes the flower.

“Your ruler has its own little garden.”

“It is not a real flower.”

“I shall not water it, then.”

He shows her the old ruler. She puts it beside her cloth.

“This part is still straight. May I have it for short marks?”

He says yes. He has a new ruler now. But Mum can still use the old one.

After supper, he draws three boxes for the next boat test. Each box needs the same space. The yellow ruler is too short to make the long line in one go.

He moves it along. The second part of the line goes slightly upwards.

Ronan rubs it out. The grey mark remains.

Dad sits beside him. He does not take the ruler.

“What moved?” he asks.

“The ruler.”

“What could stay still while you move it?”

Ronan looks at the page. He makes a small pencil mark at each end. Then he places the ruler between them. The ruler cannot reach the far mark yet. But Ronan can see the far mark. The line should end there.

The next line is better. It is not perfect, but the three boxes are clear.

Dad asks to see the price paper. He reads it and gives it back.

“You have less in your box now.”

“I know.”

“Was it worth that much to you?”

Ronan runs a finger along the smooth edge. He looks at the three empty test boxes. He will write the results in them later.

“Yes.”

He puts the ruler in his school bag. The flower sticks out above the pencil tin.

Next morning, Mei borrows the ruler. She wants to check a side on her drawing. She asks first. Ronan says yes, but wants it back before the reading lesson. She lays it beside his book when she is done.

Leo touches the printed flower.

“Does this make boats faster?”

“Only yellow boats,” Ronan says.

Leo grins. He found a plain piece of paper for his next model. He offers Ronan a corner to test the pencil on.

Ronan puts the ruler away after the lesson. Leo saw the flower. He saw the straight test boxes too.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- measure＝测量
- change＝找零
- in one go＝一次完成
- worth＝值得

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：hook＝挂钩；printed＝印着的；smooth＝平滑的。

## 读句提示

**He wants to show Mum the new ruler.**

他想／给妈妈看／新尺子。to show跟在wants后，与首章want to同类。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么选择黄色短尺？
2. Dad怎样帮助他画长线而没有替他画？
